Yes. Boeing's own 10-K says the airline industry it sells to "has been cyclical and very competitive and has experienced significant profit swings" [8]. A significant deterioration in the economy, the airline industry or major customers' finances could lead to fewer new orders, postponed or cancelled orders or payments, and lower revenues, profitability and cash flows, as well as a smaller backlog [8]. Because the commercial aircraft backlog is scheduled for delivery over several years, these impacts could unexpectedly affect deliveries over a long period [8].

Other companies' filings point the same way. One supplier says its sales to aircraft manufacturers such as Boeing and Airbus are cyclical and have had periodic downturns, including reduced Boeing and Airbus production from COVID-19 [1]. Another says its commercial aerospace business is tied to a cyclical industry [5][6].

provenance.quote: Historically, the airline industry has been cyclical and very competitive and has experienced significant profit swings

claims.text: Boeing's 10-K states that the airline industry has historically been cyclical and very competitive and has experienced significant profit swings, so Boeing's commercial business is exposed to cyclicality.

provenance.quote: could result in lower revenues, profitability and cash flows and a reduction in our contractual backlog

claims.text: Deterioration in the economy, the airline industry or major customers' finances could cause fewer new orders, postponed or cancelled orders or payments, lower revenues, profitability and cash flows, and a reduction in backlog.

provenance.quote: Our sales to manufacturers of aircraft are cyclical, and a downturn in sales to these manufacturers may adversely affect us.

claims.text: A supplier's filing says its sales to manufacturers of large commercial aircraft such as Boeing and Airbus have historically experienced periodic downturns, including decreased sales driven by reduced Boeing and Airbus production from COVID-19.

provenance.quote: the performance of those businesses is directly tied to economic conditions in the commercial aerospace industry, which is cyclical in nature

claims.text: Another company's filing says its commercial aerospace businesses are tied to economic conditions in the commercial aerospace industry, which is cyclical in nature.
